profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp describes itself as "The World's Foundation for Intelligent Operations." Its website says it powers intelligent operations to digitize, automate, and enhance processes with mobile computers, scanners, printers, RFID, and more. The company offers manufacturing technology solutions with hardware and software for automation, data analysis, and factory connectivity.

For AI, Zebra promotes Zebra Companion AI for frontline insights and support, Zebra Frontline AI Enablers with AI vision models, sample apps, and APIs, and Zebra Frontline AI Blueprints as adaptable frameworks for automating manual tasks. The Zebra Aurora suite covers machine vision software for track-and-trace, vision inspection, and industrial automation, while Zebra Aurora Focus provides a single interface for fixed industrial scanners and machine vision smart cameras. The company describes its AI as an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software, and machine vision.

Zebra Technologies Corp is a for-profit public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, trading under ticker ZBRA, with SEC CIK 0000877212. It is also listed as Zebra Technologies Corp-CL A. Illinois law exposure count is 374, and no specific cases are listed. No MCP servers are listed.
